status: Scoped local qualification; not exact final 0.5 certification
change: Cached read-only stale-head hint; duplicate/conflict/head/digest validation shared with BEGIN IMMEDIATE write admission. No write or new committed receipt is authorized by the hint.

correctness.new_regression: Hold a real BEGIN IMMEDIATE lock on another connection: stale, conflicting-event and exact retry requests resolve without the writer lock. Original source fails stale assertion after its five-second busy timeout.
correctness.unchanged_authorities: Host authorization and payload bounds precede the preflight; full coherent head, scope, retained payload and event identity checks preserve precedence; every new write revalidates transactionally.
correctness.debug_benchmarks: machine_store and machine_backpressure pass on Rust 1.100 and 1.89; all writer and bounded queue dimensions retained. One additional full release machine_store run passes on MSRV 1.89.
correctness.existing_coverage: Corruption, two-writer CAS races, coherent snapshots, write suppression/substitution, deferred commit failure, actual SIGKILL commit/outbox cuts and task/process tests remain passing.

full_fixture_method: Six full machine_store runs in B,C,C,B,B,C order, 101 measured + 8 warmup per 1/2/8/32-writer profile. Same unchanged benchmark fixture, WAL/FULL, pinned CPU 4-7, same NVMe Btrfs data parent; OS caches uncontrolled. Three run summaries per variant are exploratory, not a formal equivalence proof.
single_writer_method: Same machine_store fixture restricted to [1] in two isolated worktrees, 15 alternating paired processes, 101 + 8 commits each; complete per-call samples retained. Bootstrap interval is exploratory and does not control host/cache/storage drift.
limitations: Fast path helps requests whose read snapshot already observes a changed head. Simultaneous contenders can all read the old head and still serialize on BEGIN IMMEDIATE. No bounded worst-case completion claim.
Read-only duplicates attest to the immutable past commit, not ownership of the latest head. Invalid or false hint results never authorize a write.
The first hint unnecessarily probed the event index. The second removed that probe. The retained third also caches statement compilation; all earlier adverse measurements are preserved.
Single-writer controls use the same candidate logic before final formatting and a restricted benchmark fixture; full-profile qualification archives the exact retained source.
Single-writer v2 driver was not preserved separately; its build JSON, source patch, result files and metadata remain. The preserved v1/final drivers differ in their output-directory names.
Copied diagnostic executables excluded from the archive; SHA-256 was recorded before single-writer execution. Full-profile runner did not record binary hashes before execution.
Benchmark authorization uses the existing fast trusted-host fixture, not a real authentication service. No cold-cache, allocation or stack instrumentation claim.
Legacy encoding and timeline regression findings remain open; this is not a legacy performance waiver.
